text:
marta: quick reminder — changelog cutoff for v0.22.0 is in ~2h. please add any user-visible entries now. follow the release-notes template we agreed on (keep-a-changelog style).

devon: heads-up — if you're doing a version bump in your PR, add a single line under 'Changed' or 'Fixed' with the PR link. no long prose, just one sentence.

sam: is there a short template snippet I can paste into the PR body?

priya: yup — use this. paste under the Contributors/Changelog section in the PR:
```
## v0.22.0 - 2026-03-17
### Changed
- Describe change in one line. (PR #1234)
### Fixed
- Short bugfix summary. (PR #1235)
```

marta: small rules: 1) start with the highest-impact bucket (Added/Changed/Fixed/Security), 2) link the PR, 3) avoid internal-only details (put those in the PR body or internal changelog).

devon: also, if you’re touching CLI flags or API shapes, add a single sentence under Breaking Changes and ping @eng-platform so release notes callers can highlight it.

sam: what about squashed merges? PR number still fine?

priya: yes — PR# is enough. if it's multiple PRs, list them separated by commas.

marta: small lint check before cutoff: run `scripts/validate_changelog.py` locally. it ensures headings and date format. if it fails, fix the headings.

sam: running it now... :eyes:

release-bot: [automated] changelog lint status: 1 failure in PR #1302 — missing 'Changed' heading.

sam: fixed and force-pushed. added the one-line summary.

marta: thanks! last ask — don't add marketing copy here. we keep release notes factual; marketing will craft the blog post after GA. :rocket:

devon: will do. leaving a quick checklist in the PR template helped me a lot. maybe we should add a tiny note in the PR template that references `scripts/validate_changelog.py`?

marta: good idea — opening a small PR to update the PR template after the cut. low-risk.

priya: copied the snippet into my PR and tagged @eng-releases for visibility.

marta: perfect. cutoff in ~40m; ping here if anything blocks. thanks everyone :)
